pkgmetadata.longdescription: Firmware-only variant of amd/xdna-driver: installs the XDNA NPU firmware blobs without building the out-of-tree kernel module. Intended for monolithic kernels with CONFIG_DRM_ACCEL_AMDXDNA=y (and/or firmware embedded via CONFIG_EXTRA_FIRMWARE), where the module cannot build and the driver is already present in-kernel.
